description:
Magnum is a 52ft AS Marine flybridge motor yacht available for private charter in Dubai, offering two decks, a well thought-out flybridge and a large saloon.

She welcomes up to 17 guests, has one cabin and is run by a professional crew of 2. Departing from Dubai Marina, she is a great choice for birthdays, family days and groups of friends, with routes past Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, the Palm Jumeirah and the Burj Al Arab.

Charters are available by the hour, for sunset cruises or for the full day. Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
